# Emotional Journal with Ollama Integration

This project creates an emotional journal application that uses a local Ollama model for sentiment analysis and emotion categorization of user journal entries.

## Project Overview
- **Language**: JavaScript/Node.js
- **AI Model**: Local Ollama integration
- **Purpose**: Sentiment analysis and emotion categorization
- **Input**: User journal entries (text)
- **Output**: Emotion categories and sentiment scores

## Key Components
- Ollama API integration for local LLM inference
- Emotion classification system
- Journal entry processing
- Sentiment analysis pipeline

## Development Guidelines
- Use modern JavaScript (ES6+) features
- Implement proper error handling for Ollama API calls
- Create modular code structure for different emotion categories
- Ensure proper input validation and sanitization
- Follow async/await patterns for API interactions
